vetSays.line: 🛡️ Carmine, Duc, David, Onni and Chantal met them at the door — 5 put down. Carmine, Duc, David, Chantal are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Carmine just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Carmine, George, Verónica, Duc and Elif met them at the door — 5 put down. Carmine, George, Verónica, Duc, Elif are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Verónica just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Verónica — Craft 1. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Verónica chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 1.
Verónica shows you Cold-Blooded — not the power, just the shape of it. Watch and learn.
📓 Codex: you've SEEN Cold-Blooded now. You need 20% less food in cold weather. Your body budgets like an accountant.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Carmine just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Elif just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? David just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Carmine, Verónica, Duc, Elif and David met them at the door — 5 put down. Carmine, Duc, Elif, David are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Verónica Elizondo, 27 — a mason. Her hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Fusion Reactor, Cold-Blooded.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Hoa just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
